intervalAttribution: WAL, temp, database and filesystem deltas include all concurrent production activity; graph relation allocation is measured directly. No claim of isolated WAL/temp cost.
rationale: 96 MiB reserve is 1.74 times measured graph allocation. Counts allow about 25% growth (bounded pairs about 28%); total serialized row bytes allow 25%, maximum row width 5%. Count/width and physical allocation guards refuse excess. Full 29-day overlap fits without crediting any purge. A fixed DB ceiling preserves over 4 GB of presently observed filesystem space for WAL, temp and other non-database allocation. Other database growth can make refresh refuse sooner; no forecast of guaranteed 29-day availability and no continuous filesystem monitoring.
